kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتباحث (form VI)
# نَتَبَاحَثُ (natabāḥaṯu) /na.ta.baː.ħa.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَاحَثَ (tabāḥaṯa)
# نَتَبَاحَثَ (natabāḥaṯa) /na.ta.baː.ħa.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاحَثَ (tabāḥaṯa)
# نَتَبَاحَثْ (natabāḥaṯ) /na.ta.baː.ħaθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَاحَثَ (tabāḥaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
